jobs.title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
jobs.description: Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes. Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber. Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher. Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route. Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil. Tu as

jobs.description: Du steuerst die Invasion. Wir bringen Marken in Kioske, Mini-Märkte und Tankstellenshops. Jede Marke braucht einen Plan, eine Tour und einen Report. Du sorgst dafür, dass alle drei stehen. Über uns Impuls Invasion ist eine FMCG-Handelsagentur aus Hamburg, gegründet 2026. Wir arbeiten für Hersteller und Marken im Impulskanal. Unser Außendienst ist in Hamburg und Berlin unterwegs. Jede Marke sieht Besuche, Distribution und Platzierungen in unserem Live-Tool. Nach 12 Monaten Du leitest die Projekte mehrerer Marken selbst. Jeder Monatsreport geht pünktlich raus. Du hast ein neues Projekt vom Angebot bis zum Start gebracht und weißt, welche Tour sich rechnet. Dein Job Kundenprojekte leiten. Du bist Ansprechperson für mehrere Marken. Du planst Maßnahmen, hältst Termine und lieferst Ergebnisse. Außendienst steuern. Du planst Touren mit unserem Team in Hamburg und Berlin und koordinierst unsere Handelsvertretungen. Ab und zu fährst du selbst mit. Auswertungen ziehen. Du holst Besuche, Distribution und Platzierungen aus unserem Live-Tool. Daraus baust du Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen. Neue Projekte aufbauen. Du rechnest Angebote mit, setzt Piloten auf und bringst neue Marken in bestehende Touren. Woran wir dich messen Jede Marke hat ihren Monatsreport, bevor sie danach fragt. Geplante Besuche finden statt. Abweichungen kennst du vor der Marke. Jedes neue Projekt startet mit Kalkulation, Tourplan und KPI-Set. Das brauchst du Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Handel, Gastro oder Agentur. Job, Ausbildung und Werkstudium zählen. Kundenkontakt, am Telefon oder vor Ort. Auswertungen in Excel oder Google Sheets, aus Job, Studium oder Projekt. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift. Ein Plus Du hast schon etwas selbst verantwortet: ein Projekt, ein Team, eine Schicht oder einen Verein. Türkisch oder Arabisch. Du bekommst Fixum plus Bonus auf deine Ziele. Die Gehaltsspanne steht in unserer ersten Antwort. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit. Du sagst uns, wie viele Stunden du arbeiten willst. Home

jobs.description: About TACTILIA At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of SCHUNK, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role As Senior Industrialization & Supply Chain Manager you will take ownership of the industrialization perspective throughout the product development process. Working closely with R&D, engineering and external manufacturing partners, you will ensure that manufacturing considerations are integrated into product design from the earliest development stages. You will challenge existing design decisions where necessary, identify more suitable manufacturing technologies and processes, and drive the transition from engineering concepts and prototypes to manufacturable, scalable products. This is a key role for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of engineering, product development and manufacturing – and who is equally comfortable discussing technical trade-offs with R&D engineers, negotiating with suppliers and engaging directly with people on the production floor. What you will do: Drive industrialization from early product development: Work closely with R&D engineers from the beginning of the development process, integrating manufacturing expertise into design decisions and challenging concepts where necessary to improve manufacturability, cost and scalability. jobs.description: Our Digital Procurement & Pricing team is looking for a Digital Product Manager - Price Management (ContextIQ) (f/m/d) on a Permanent Contract (CDI) based in Lille (Upline) . Within Decathlon s digital organization, our team designs decision-support solutions for Procurement teams worldwide. Working hand in hand with the Purchase COE (Center of Excellence), we develop digital products such as ContextIQ, PYC, and Datacost to power strategic sourcing through context and data. We are looking for a Product Manager focused on business impact, user-centricity, and data-driven solutions to lead the evolution of ContextIQ. YOUR FUTURE CONTRIBUTION As the Digital Product Manager for ContextIQ, your mission will be to turn complex procurement needs into an intuitive user experience and a prioritized, high-value backlog: Product Vision & Strategy : Define the product roadmap, strategic vision, and clear success metrics (adoption, usability, business value delivered). Product Discovery & Prototyping : Uncover buyer needs, design intuitive user journeys, and test prototypes with users. Delivery & Prioritization : Translate business needs into clear user stories, prioritize features based on value, and collaborate closely with engineering teams throughout delivery. jobs.description: PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC) adalah perusahaan yang bergerak pada bidang jasa penunjang dalam industri energi di Indonesia. Anak Perusahaan PT Pertamina Drilling Services Indonesia (Pertamina Drilling) yang merupakan bagian dari Subholding Upstream Pertamina. Lowongan Kerja PT Patra Drilling Contractor (PDC). PDC (selanjutnya disebut sebagai Perseroan) didirikan pada 11 September 1981 sebagai perusahaan nasional pertama yang fokus menyediakan layanan pengeboran lepas pantai di Indonesia sebagai prioritas pertama. Setelah 38 tahun berkontribusi dalam penyediaan energi nasional, Perseroan semakin memantapkan langkahnya menjadi perusahaan jasa penunjang industri energi terdepan yang mengutamakan keseimbangan antara aspek people dan , profit dan planet. Hal tersebut dibuktikan dengan pertumbuhan kinerja Perseroan secara eksponensial yang diiringi dengan penguatan pada aspek sosial dan lingkungan. jobs.title: Import Department Buyer
jobs.description: Position Overview : We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented Supply Chain Associate / Import Buyer to join our growing team. The Supply Chain Associate handles communication with global suppliers and assists in the product development cycle. This role is essential in managing the end-to-end supply chain processes, particularly focused on international purchasing, vendor management, and ensuring timely and cost-effective importation of goods. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of global supply chains, procurement practices, and import regulations. Key responsibilities include : Vendor Management: Identify and establish relationships with international suppliers and negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts. Purchasing & Procurement: Manage the procurement of goods from international markets, ensuring the best quality, price, and delivery terms. Order Management: Place and track purchase orders, manage order confirmations, and resolve discrepancies with suppliers. Logistics Coordination: Coordinate shipments with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery of imported goods. Import Documentation: Ensure all required documents (commercial invoices, bills of lading, certificates of origin, etc.) are accurate and compliant with international and local regulations. Inventory Management: Monitor stock levels and work with internal teams to ensure optimal inventory levels are maintained. Customs Compliance: Ensure adherence to all customs laws, regulations, and import/export guidelines, including tariff classifications and duty calculations. Cost Control: Analyze and manage procurement costs to align with budgetary goals and maximize savings. Vendor Performance Evaluation: Track supplier performance, delivery times, and quality, and work with vendors to improve service. Supply Chain Optimization: Continuously evaluate the supply chain processes and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs. Risk Managemen
